config.loss: case-balanced relative-case MSE of3 signed u components; fixed train-only RMS weights, unchanged common zero-center decode
config.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation15-case mean all-original-node physical displacement vector relativeL2
config.stress_policy: freeze independently supervised strict stress branch; do not combine stress or train it with u loss
config.precision: PointNet float32/high TF32; native TCNN FP16 compute/FP32 master; physical u/strain geometry arithmetic and metrics float64

definition.fit_data: all labels of the selected training cases; no validation/test labels
definition.scale: 90th percentile of abs(stress), or RMS if that percentile is zero; floor 1e-12
definition.spread: pooled population standard deviation of asinh(stress / scale); floor 1e-8

stress_reference.policy: independently supervised signed scalar stress, frozen reference; no stress optimization or linear composition
